title: event.listen active_history flag for attributes does not propagate
body:
from #4691 

not sure why we have this flag in two places like this, if this can be fixed simply we should do it.
```

from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, ForeignKey, create_engine, event
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship, sessionmaker

Base = declarative_base()


class Translation(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'translations'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)

    en = Column(String(255))
    nl = Column(String(255))
    fr = Column(String(255))


class BasePool(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'Pool'
    __mapper_args__ = {
        'polymorphic_on': 'type',
        'with_polymorphic': '*'
    }

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    type = Column(String(255), nullable=False, index=True)

    name_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(Translation.id), nullable=True)
    name = relationship(Translation)

@event.listens_for(BasePool.name, 'set', retval=True, active_history=True, propagate=True)
def attr_set_hook(state, value, oldvalue, initiator):
    # I expect oldvalue here to be either a Translation or a None, but instead I get NEVER_SET
    assert isinstance(oldvalue, Translation) or oldvalue is None  # This breaks!
    # potential modification to oldvalue...
    if oldvalue is None:
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return Translation(**value)
        return value
    else:
        # Modify inplace oldvalue
        oldvalue.en = value['en'] if isinstance(value, dict) else value.en
        oldvalue.fr = value['fr'] if isinstance(value, dict) else value.fr
        oldvalue.nl = value['nl'] if isinstance(value, dict) else value.nl
        return oldvalue


class SimplePool(BasePool):
    """Simple concrete class, needed just to show the behaviour"""
    __mapper_args__ = {'polymorphic_identity': 'simple'}


engine = create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:')
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)

session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)()

b = BasePool()
b.name = {'en': 'A simple pool', 'nl': 'A simple pool in Dutch'}  # This works

p = SimplePool()
p.name = {'en': 'A simple pool', 'nl': 'A simple pool in Dutch'}  # This trigg
```
